channel.title: Strictly Come Dancing
channel.desc: Get ready for some incredible transformations as our remaining couples take on Icons Week, with routines inspired by some of the best-loved recording artists in history. As always, Shirley Ballas, Craig Revel Horwood, Motsi Mabuse and Anton Du Beke provide expert advice and scores. By the end of the night, who will you think has delivered a performance worthy of the Strictly hall of fame?
